units.heightDepth: The height/depth does not refer to the height/depth labels within a map layer. These are completely independent of this setting. The height/depth labels within a map layer are solely dependent on the source of the map layer.
units.unit: Select the unit system used to display values of this type throughout the app.
units.decimalPlaces: Number of decimal places shown for values of this unit type. Higher values show more digits after the decimal point for greater precision.
units.coordsPadLng: If enabled, the longitude will be padded to three digits. E.g. '012°' instead of '12°'.
units.coordsPadLat: If enabled, the latitude will be padded to two digits. E.g. '02°' instead of '2°'.
units.coordsForceNE: If enabled, north and east will always be used instead of south and west. Negative values indicate south or west. E.g. '-12°E' instead of '12°W'.
units.coordsOrder: Determines which coordinate components are displayed and in which order.

hint.hardwareKey: Assign an action to this hardware button. Map the volume keys to zoom the map in and out, or set them to do nothing to prevent accidental zoom changes.
hint.dateTimeFormat: Dates and times are formatted using day.js. See the documentation for available format options.
hint.dateTimeHintDefault:
Customize how dates and times are displayed throughout the app.

When enabled, dates and times are displayed using the default format %s. Turn off to enter a custom day.js format string.
hint.dateTimeHintCustom: Enter a custom day.js format string to control how dates and times appear throughout the app.

timeZoneNotice: Timezone is fixed to UTC. Time is always shown in 24-hour format.
